events.description: A man in a grey suit attacks James Bond (in white tuxedo) with a sudden lunge and physical strike; Bond is thrown backward into a chair.
A hand holds a pistol pointed upward; muzzle flash and smoke are visible, indicating a shot has just been fired.

A man in a white tuxedo is engaged in a violent physical struggle with an opponent inside a train dining car; the sequence shows grappling, being thrown across the compartment, and being pinned on a table.

Two men engage in a close-quarters physical struggle inside a confined wooden space (likely an elevator). The man in the light-colored shirt is initially grabbed and pushed, then counters with aggressive strikes and grappling; the bearded man in the darker jacket maintains control through clinching, headlocks, and forceful repositioning. The sequence shows mutual engagement, reciprocal strikes, and dynamic grappling without clear victim/perpetrator distinction until late frames where one appears subdued.

Two men engage in close-quarters physical combat: one man in a dark suit grabs and strikes the other (in white shirt), who is initially restrained against a wall/mirror; the struggle involves grappling, choking, and forceful impacts.

After the initial fight, the attacker (dark suit) overpowers the victim (white shirt), who is now on the floor and appears helpless; the attacker continues to strike or压制 the victim while he lies prone, indicating non-consensual violence against a subdued person.

Two men engage in close-quarters physical combat: one in a white shirt is thrown or falls onto a table (f2–f3), then both are on the floor with grappling and striking motions (f4–f6); the man in dark clothing appears to dominate, pinning and striking the other (f7–f8).

After the initial fight, the man in dark clothing is seen kneeling over the subdued man in white, delivering repeated strikes while the victim lies helpless on the floor (f7–f9), indicating non-consensual violence against a defenseless person.

A second round of physical confrontation occurs: the man in white rises and swings an object (possibly a bottle) at the other man (f10–f11); they re-engage in close combat, with visible grappling and aggressive postures (f12–f15).
